t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I need to switch between the gyob genomes and collect equal amounts of mushrooms between them

vb_textbox.text: keep you finger on the "S" and "K" on the keyboard at all times and press the space bar when collecting the mushrooms also remember to select the glob genomes as they are the name ones after which also select the other coloured genomes and ensure to be focused and be seated comfortably with enough arm support. don't get distracted as this will affect your speed and response time,
